completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-31-2016-MUNICIPAL-BOARDS-ACT-AMENDMENT-ORDER-2016.pdf》（2 页），本次切分 3 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Municipal Boards Act (Amendment) Order, 2016 and shall be deemed to have commenced on 15th March 2016.
Section 2 of the Municipal Boards Act, in this Order referred to as the Act, is amended by deleting the definition of "sky-sign". Amendment of section 4

Section 4 of the Act is amended by deleting paragraph (0). Made this 5th. day of Sya'ban, 1437 Hijriah corresponding to the 12th. day of May, 2016 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM Dicetak oleh Jabatan Percetakan Kcrajaan, Bandar Seri Begawan KB:3510, Negara Brunei Darussalam.
